💥 10 दिनों में ₹1228 crore का वर्ल्डवाइड कलेक्शन करके रणबीर कपूर की फिल्म Ramayana ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तहलका मचा दिया है!

Nitesh Tiwari के निर्देशन में बनी इस फिल्म ने 10वें दिन इंडिया में ₹72.90 crore का नेट कलेक्शन किया, जिससे इंडिया का कुल ग्रॉस ₹819.50 crore और ओवरसीज ग्रॉस ₹408.50 crore तक पहुंच गया।

इस फिल्म ने महज 9 दिनों में 1000 करोड़ का क्लब जॉइन करके Baahubali 2, RRR, Jawan और Pathaan जैसी ब्लॉकबस्टर फिल्मों को पीछे छोड़ दिया है। 🔥

हालांकि, 10वें दिन ₹1255.41 crore कलेक्शन के साथ Ranveer Singh की फिल्म Dhurandhar: The Revenge अभी भी इस रेस में सबसे आगे बनी हुई है।

एक और बड़ी उपलब्धि यह है कि Goa में 20 November से शुरू हो रहे 57th IFFI के BRICS सेगमेंट में दिखाई जाने वाली यह पहली फिल्म बनेगी। 🎬

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana जल्द ही Dhurandhar 2 को पीछे छोड़ पाएगी? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर शेयर करें! 👇

ctx.title: Ramayana worldwide box office collection day 10: Ranbir Kapoor's epic crosses  ₹1200 crore, but Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar 2 stays ahead in the race
ctx.summary: Titled Ramayana: Rise of a Legend in international markets, the mythological drama features Ranbir as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana.
ctx.text:
Ranbir Kapoor 's Ramayana has had a terrific run at the box office, crossing the ₹ 1000 crore mark worldwide within just nine days of its release. The Nitesh Tiwari-directed film, which hit theatres on November 5 during the Diwali festive season, has continued to draw audiences in India and overseas. Titled Ramayana: Rise of a Legend in international markets, the mythological drama features Ranbir as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The film is the first part of a two-film saga, with the second instalment expected to release in 2028.
According to the trade tracker Sacnilk, Ramayana saw another strong day at the box office on Saturday. On day 10, the film earned ₹ 72.90 crore net in India across 23,451 shows. The film's total India gross has now reached ₹ 819.50 crore. After adding ₹ 30 crore, the film's overseas gross stands at ₹ 408.50 crore. This takes its worldwide collection to ₹ 1228 crore in just ten days.
While Ramayana has recorded an impressive day 10 collection in India, it is still trailing Aditya Dhar and Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar: The Revenge at the worldwide box office. The film continues to hold the top spot, despite Ramayana's rapid growth over the past few days. By day 10, Dhurandhar 2 had recorded ₹ 1255.41 crore collection at the box office.
However, Ramayana's journey to the ₹ 1000 crore club has been faster than several major Indian blockbusters. Only Pushpa 2: The Rule and Dhurandhar: The Revenge reached the milestone sooner, taking seven days each. Ramayana managed it in nine days, beating Baahubali 2, which took 10 days, RRR, which needed 16 days, and KGF: Chapter 2, which took 18 days. It has also reached the milestone much faster than Shah Rukh Khan's Jawan and Pathaan. While Jawan took 18 days to cross ₹ 1000 crore worldwide, Pathaan took 27 days. Ramayana's numbers reflect the strong response the film has received across its different language versions and international markets.
The film's box office success is not its only recent achievement. Ramayana will also be the first film screened in the BRICS segment at the 57th edition of the International Film Festival of India (IFFI), which is scheduled to begin in Goa on November 20. According to the Press Information Bureau (PIB), the segment will feature films from all 11 BRICS member countries, as well as partner nations. The initiative aims to bring films from around the world to Indian audiences and showcase a range of cinematic styles and stories.
